title: It wasn't worth it !!
text: Well it was worth a shot ! But I gotta pass cause as you can see from beginning to end the last photo its not looking good , my plant arrived in bad shape and the driver left the box upside down ( no way to tell which end was up ) after getting it planted I was hoping it would make it 😬but its dieing 😭slowly its going the process of shipping was just to hard for it so I wont be continuing my Subscription 😞 2 leafs left barely hanging on !! I really think the care given to the plant during shipping was crap ! Maybe a brighter box like orange or red with a warning or fragile ! For shippers to take notice idk but the box was just thrown around like all the rest ! The box was dented , you could see it was not handled well ! So try the service if you want but thats my story 🙏🌿🌱🌵🍀🙏
label: negative
